subject: TASK-TDL-001

evidence.summary: Authoritative finding 1 (repeat, attempts 2): TASK-TDL-001 implements contains 'G-DL-001... placeholder check', not a host-listed id. PRD line 72 confirms the real id is G-DL-001 (goals table, section 3); the placeholder text was left unexpanded. Repair: implements = [REQ-DL-082, G-DL-001, G-DL-002, G-DL-003], all host-listed.

Authoritative findings 3-5 (TASK-TDL-001 block edges to TDL-003/009/010 without consumer-side declaration). Repair adds TASK-TDL-001 ordering_only depends_on entries to TASK-TDL-003, TASK-TDL-009 and TASK-TDL-010; the blocks arrays of those consumer records already carry the reciprocal edge, so the pair is now declared on both sides.

TASK-TDL-001 keeps its sole deliverable crates/archon-trading/src/lib.rs (kind prd-contract-statement, min_instances 1) - verified present in the repo; it anchors REQ-DL-082 redaction discipline (crates/archon-trading/src/data_lake/redaction.rs implements REQ-DL-082 via lib-reachable surface) and the G-DL-001..003 upgrade arc stated in section 2.

commands_run.output_summary: Line 72: '| G-DL-001 | Upgrade the existing OHLCV store into Trading Data Lake v1. |' - confirms G-DL-001 is a host-listed goals-table id; candidate's 'G-DL-001... placeholder check' literal was an unexpanded placeholder.
lib.rs declares data_store, data_lake, coverage, backtest_gates, ahdm_backtest, providers, validation - the modules every downstream task consumes from TASK-TDL-001's lib.rs surface.

summary: TASK-TDL-001 re-landed: placeholder id replaced with host-listed G-DL-001; ordering-only consumer edges to TDL-003/009/010 declared in depends_on; deliverable and retained implements unchanged.
